# source data rows

    if src.cell(r,1).value not in (None,''):
        src_rows.append(r)
print('src rows', src_rows)

# first empty row in dest (col A)
start=5
while dst.cell(start,1).value not in (None,''):
    start+=1
print('start row', start)

# mapping dest col index -> (src col index, transform)
# A,B,C,D direct; E<-I; F,G direct; H blank; I 'Credit Note'; J direct; K direct; L=-L; M=-M; N,O,P,Q,R,S,T,U,V direct
mapping={
 1:1, 2:2, 3:3, 4:4,
 5:9,  # E <- I
 6:6, 7:7,

 9:'Credit Note',

 14:14,15:15,16:16,17:17,18:18,19:19,20:20,21:21,22:22

out_row=start
